title: Bainbridge Island Ferry Adventure Troll, History and Waterfront
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Bainbridge Island the way locals do. This tour combines a scenic Washington State Ferry crossing, charming waterfront streets, fascinating World War II history, beautiful parks, and Thomas Dambo’s famous wooden troll. With hotel pickup, round-trip ferry tickets included, and a knowledgeable local driver-guide, you’ll enjoy a relaxed, authentic Pacific Northwest experience beyond Seattle.
